forecasting_method: CEEMDAN is recomputed on each station's historical prefix. A new LSTM is trained at each forecast origin.
limitations: Only a small number of observations are available per station.
Each station-specific LSTM has very few training windows.
CEEMDAN components may be unstable for short sequences.
Results are preliminary and require evaluation on additional DOE data.
This validation evaluates one-step-ahead forecasts of the next observed sample, not a fixed daily or monthly horizon.
